statement.p: Let V be the plane with equation x_1 + 2 x_2 - 4 x_3 =0 in {\mathbb R}^3. The linear transformation T\left(\begin{bmatrix}x_1\\x_2\\x_3\end{bmatrix}\right)= \left[\begin{array}{ccc} -6 \amp -2 \amp -4\cr 1 \amp -1 \amp -2\cr -1 \amp -1 \amp -2 \end{array}\right] \begin{bmatrix}x_1\\x_2\\x_3\end{bmatrix} maps V into V so, by restricting it to V, we may regard it as a linear transformation \tilde T \colon V \to V.

Find the matrix A of the restricted map \tilde T \colon V \to V with respect to the basis \left\lbrace \left[\begin{array}{c} -2\cr 1\cr 0 \end{array}\right], \left[\begin{array}{c} 4\cr 0\cr 1 \end{array}\right] \right\rbrace.
